card.name: Words just before a country or city name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "into", and some number or title slots, right before a nation, people, city or kingdom is named. Seen in history, politics and Bible text.

modes.label: Of before a nation or people
modes.description: The word "of" comes right before a country, city or people name.

modes.label: Other links before a place
modes.description: A verb-linked word or a pronoun comes before a town or kingdom.

modes.label: Scripture and law references
modes.description: The spot before a chapter or clause number in a citation.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like nation, kingdom and city as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before a nation, kingdom or city is named.
